about: Gzipped bytes, at zlib's default level as gzip -c gives. The shell's limit is the architecture's budget for the base client bundle, 2 MB compressed. Each package's limit is its size on 2026-09-10 plus about a quarter, so a regression fails the build and growth is a decision. KaTeX is fetched only when an answer has maths, so it is held apart from the shell's 2 MB, at its size as CI first measured it (333.2 KB, 2026-10-17) plus about a quarter. @localspace/ui was raised to 12 KB on 2026-10-30, approved, for the design system's components (Badge, Notice, Progress). Automerge's WebAssembly is a vendor file held at the exact size of the version in use: any change to it is a version change, noticed on purpose.

limits.name: KaTeX 0.19.0, fetched with the first formula: its script, stylesheet and woff2 fonts
